competitorWins: N2YO is the deeper dedicated satellite-tracking tool: TLE-based positions for a large satellite catalogue, the International Space Station, pass predictions calculated for your location, satellite categories and technical details, and a documented API for developers. For amateur-radio users, satellite spotters and anyone planning around a specific pass, that single-purpose depth and history beat a generalist globe.
description: N2YO is a satellite-tracking website: ISS and satellite positions from TLE data, pass predictions for your location, a large satellite catalogue, and an API, free with advertising. It tracks objects in orbit only — no flights, ships, cameras or weather. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: live satellites on a free 3D globe together with flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, weather, earthquakes and wildfires — no signup needed.
